ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Thread Creation In Mstsc.Exe From Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects remote thread creation in the "mstsc.exe" process by a process located in a potentially suspicious location.
This technique is often used by attackers in order to hook some APIs used by DLLs loaded by "mstsc.exe" during RDP authentications in order to steal credentials.
 Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, SourceImage

sequences.query: (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\mstsc\\\.exe$") AND (SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
